consent.title: Call tracking
consent.heading: Record your calls with customers
consent.summary: LeadBee can keep your call history with customers up to date on its own, so you never have to write a call down.

read.title: What is read
read.body: The call log on your phone: the number, time, type of call and how long it lasted. Never the content of a call.

private.title: What stays on your phone
private.body: Your phone checks each number first. Only calls with customers in LeadBee are sent. Calls with family, friends or anyone else are discarded on the device and never uploaded.

shared.title: Who can see them
shared.body: You, and the managers of your organization — the same people who already see your leads, tasks and meetings.

stop.title: You can stop any time
stop.body: Turn it off in Profile → Settings → Call tracking, or in Android settings. LeadBee keeps working either way.

consent.policy: Read how LeadBee handles call data
consent.policyUnavailable: Couldn't open the policy. It is also linked on the Play Store listing.
consent.footnote: Android only. iPhone does not allow any app to read its call history.
consent.deniedBody: Call tracking stays off. Everything else in LeadBee works as before.
